beats.text: Djibouti uses 84.2% of its water for homes. In Somalia, it is just 0.5%.
Somalia is the world's lowest. Almost every drop there goes to farming instead of the tap.
Djibouti uses 11 times more for its homes than India. Djibouti: 84.2%. India: 7.4%.
Domestic use includes drinking water, municipal supply, and public services.
Germany uses 41.5% for its homes, much closer to the top.
These nations use the least: Mali: 2.1%. Laos: 1.8%. Vietnam: 1.5%.
The USA uses 13.1% for its homes, while China hits the median at 20.1%.
